# `config`

Update config.yaml by syncing all default config sections/keys

- Wrapper: [`job_config.sh`](https://github.com/dr-michael-haley/imcanalysis/blob/main/SLURM_scripts/job_config.sh)
- Conda environment: `sbt-analysis`
- Python module: `SpatialBiologyToolkit.scripts.update_config`

## Inputs

- config.yaml (created if missing)

## Outputs

- config.yaml (updated in place)
- outputs/<execution_id>_Configuration_Maintenance/ stage report under sbt

## Configuration

- all blocks (sync defaults): general, preprocess, denoising, createmasks, segmentation, nimbus, process, visualization, cellcharter, pairwise_spatial, networkx_spatial, remap_obs, subclustering, logging

## Run

From the dataset directory containing `config.yaml`:

```bash
pl config
```
